subject.title: Ollama local provider: native tool_calls not recognized, falls back to unreliable JSON-text parsing

question: Should maintainers require a live OpenClaw request/response capture before queueing a fix for this Ollama tool-call report, or treat the related native-failure issue as enough proof to start implementation?
rationale: Current source already supports native `tool_calls`, but the report includes a `/v1` route and the strongest related evidence has a different terminal symptom, so automation should not guess the root cause.

options.title: Require live capture first
options.body: Collect redacted OpenClaw `onPayload`/NDJSON evidence for the failing local Ollama turn before selecting a fix boundary.

options.title: Canonicalize under related native issue
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101445 as the main investigation thread if maintainers decide both reports share the same native parser/request root cause.

options.title: Treat as documented `/v1` misconfiguration
options.body: Close only if the reporter confirms their active model route was OpenAI-compatible `/v1` rather than native `api: "ollama"`.

recommendation.title: Require live capture first
recommendation.body: Collect redacted OpenClaw `onPayload`/NDJSON evidence for the failing local Ollama turn before selecting a fix boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-source and recent-history signals for Ollama stream handling and the diagnostic warning path point to steipete, with the caveat that native-provider history is shared.
